claim_ceiling: Independent CPU implementation of the published and pinned MATLAB consensus-coupled adaptive-noise swarm optimizer with numerical safeguards; not yet a source-reproduced, qualified optimizer, or physical swarm controller

implementation.implementation_style: independently authored Rust reference from published mathematical description
implementation.update_order: synchronous; all agents update from a shared previous-state snapshot
implementation.function_evaluation_accounting: initial observations are cached; first step counts initial plus successor observations; each subsequent step counts the newly observed successor positions
implementation.transactional_update: Agent positions, RNG, tick, successor cache and consensus history commit only after the complete successor observation batch validates. Successfully acquired initial observations and their function-evaluation cost remain cached/countable if a later successor batch fails; no partial movement commits.
implementation.function_evaluation_contract: Step candidates and successor observations are built locally; positions, RNG state, cache, tick, history and counters commit only if all successor observations validate.

social_kernel.published_discrete_update: The published discrete-time model equation uses pi/2 inside the sine.
social_kernel.pinned_matlab_source: SCM/tstep.m at the pinned upstream commit uses sin(dx_ij.*pi/2).

numerical_assurance.zero_mean_gradient: Use finite zero fitness-gradient gain and flag gradient_degenerate; avoid xi = 1/0.
numerical_assurance.zero_agent_spread: Set all lambda weights to zero and flag swarm_spread_degenerate; avoid division by Dmax=0.
numerical_assurance.equal_fitness: Use unweighted centroid fallback if shifted fitness weights sum below epsilon.
numerical_assurance.zero_consensus_trend: Do not update sigma if I1-I2 is exactly zero; avoid 0/0.
numerical_assurance.out_of_domain: Use declared conical barrier gradient with H=-0.5 and angle=20 degrees; outside observations carry zero fitness.
numerical_assurance.transaction: Candidate positions, RNG state, observations, history and counters commit only if all successor observations succeed.
numerical_assurance.deterministic_replay: Exact same seed, initial state, config, landscape and supported platform replay identically within this Rust implementation.

unit_controls.purpose: Prevent regression to the previously misread 2/pi sine argument and pin the shared published/MATLAB update term.
Ensure deterministic reproducibility of the independent Rust implementation.
unit_controls.expected: complete ScmModel state and ScmStepReport sequence compare equal

unit_controls.purpose: Exercise Dmax=0 without NaN or infinite lambda weights.
unit_controls.expected: swarm_spread_degenerate is true and positions/consensus remain finite

unit_controls.purpose: Exercise xi=1/mean(||gradient||) at a zero-gradient state.
unit_controls.expected: gradient_degenerate is true; finite zero-gain fallback is used

unit_controls.purpose: Exercise I1-I2=0 in the adaptive sigma update.
unit_controls.expected: sigma remains finite and at its initial value

unit_controls.purpose: Verify finite conical barrier observations for positions outside the unit domain.
unit_controls.landscape: unit-bounded quadratic; not queried for out-of-domain points
unit_controls.expected: both agents are recorded as outside-domain; state remains finite

unit_controls.purpose: Count initial and successor observations explicitly.
Inject a failure during successor observation and ensure no partial model-state commit.
unit_controls.injected_failure: landscape evaluator fails on first successor observation after initial three-agent observation
unit_controls.expected: On a successor observation error, agent positions, RNG and tick remain unchanged; a completed initial batch remains cached and counted; every attempted successor observation up to and including the failed call is also counted.

unit_controls.purpose: Prevent out-of-range dimensionless fitness from contaminating centroid/consensus calculations.
Prove the paper and repository discrete window schedules have distinct first update ticks.
Ensure a finite but very large out-of-domain coordinate cannot overflow while normalizing the conical barrier gradient.
unit_controls.expected: Barrier gradient and updated state remain finite; both agents remain explicitly outside the dimensionless domain.

source_reproduction.resolution: Published discrete equation and pinned MATLAB tstep.m both use sin((pi/2)*delta_x); the earlier claimed 2/pi paper variant was a misreading and has been removed.

qualification_next_steps: Run exact-head fmt, strict Clippy and unit tests for the single published/MATLAB pi/2 social kernel; keep consensus-window indexing as a separate discrete reproduction sensitivity.
Run cargo fmt and cargo test for symtropy-lifesim-core at the exact PR head.
Have an independent reviewer compare the Rust update against both the article equations and the pinned tstep/consensus source.
Add normalized Ackley and Rastrigin landscapes and reproduce the SCM 100-replication source protocol.
Implement matched PSO and MIPA baselines with identical initial states, sensor/function-evaluation budgets and success criteria.
Add moving peak/advection scenarios and network constraints before comparing the AUV proof-of-concept.

consensus_window_controls.semantics: Exactly tau_steps consensus observations; split into two disjoint equal halves; first update at tick tau_steps.
consensus_window_controls.purpose: Implements the equal-width continuous-time half-window description.

consensus_window_controls.semantics: tau_steps+1 observations; early sum uses tau_steps/2+1 values, late sum uses tau_steps/2 values; first update at tick tau_steps+1.
consensus_window_controls.purpose: Reproduces the inclusive array-index schedule observed in the inspected MATLAB replication loop; not identical to the paper's equal half-interval definition.

task_performance_outputs.historical_progress: best_fitness_seen is monotonic and includes all successfully acquired initial and successor observations
task_performance_outputs.separation_rule: SCM consensus, centroid cohesion, and communication degree are reported separately from task fitness; no consensus value is a substitute for objective performance.
task_performance_outputs.accounting: Under the cache contract, N agents over T completed steps require N*(T+1) objective evaluations: N initial evaluations plus N successor evaluations per step.

topology_controls.purpose: Independent local-update baseline; must create no adjacency even for duplicate positions
topology_controls.expected: mean_communicating_neighbors=0 and isolated_agents=agent_count for every valid population
